### Consulting The Lord
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/consulting-the-lord-one-year-devotions-for-men-october-21.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 5:19
Points:
- Despite having seasoned soldiers and extensive military expertise, David recognized his need for divine guidance.
- God offers wisdom freely to His people, yet many neglect to seek His counsel.
- Men often encounter unnecessary hardship by relying on self-confidence and personal instincts.
- Christians can consult the Lord by praying, studying Scripture, seeking godly counsel, and trusting the Holy Spirit.

### A Prayer for Breakthrough in Spiritual Warfare
Author: Jaime Hampton
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/a-prayer-for-breakthrough-in-spiritual-warfare.html
Passage: 2 Samuel 5:19-21
Points:
- David confronted a formidable, entrenched enemy with confident faith in God's power.
- The name Baal-perazim celebrates the Lord as the God of breakthrough who sweeps away obstacles.
- Believers are encouraged to bring seemingly impossible struggles to God instead of depending on human strength.
- Expectant prayer invites God into the battle and defines victory by His standards.
